summary: This spec describes "Learn mode", a split-screen layout that replaces a camera walk through a canvas's sections. A guide with the section text sits on the left, tabs on the right show the current stop's card, and one shared composer sits at the bottom.

options.label: When Learn mode starts and ends
options.what: You will see that Learn mode is on exactly while a walk runs, what starts and ends it, and what it keeps and restores.

options.label: Top row and left guide
options.what: You will understand the walk pill, the Learn and Canvas toggle, and how the guide shows the heading, lead text and follow text.

options.label: Cards, Canvas, TOC and Chat tabs
options.what: You will learn what each right-hand tab shows, including how a card is scaled to fit and why a notebook stop is handled differently.

options.label: No Focus and a single composer
options.what: You will see why every path into Focus is removed and how one composer serves every tab and sends replies to Chat.

options.label: Kept features and tests
options.what: You will learn which walk features remain, which are dropped, and which tests cover the behaviour.

cannot.why: It names components and files but includes no code, so you cannot see how anything is built.

cannot.thing: Why the earlier camera walk design was chosen
cannot.why: It only says the card was too small to read.
